title: The Coming Elections in Europe That Will Shape the Region's Security
gist: Warcast episode notes: Serbia's Oct. 25 parliamentary elections saw a student-led opposition oust long-time leader Aleksandar Vucic, the first in a string of consequential European elections including Spain, France, Italy and Poland. Gesine Weber discusses the drivers of far-right gains and backlash and implications for the EU, NATO and European security.
